name: Selective Immunoglobulin M Deficiency

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Selective IgM Deficiency

criteria.description: Serum IgM level below age-adjusted reference range
Normal serum levels of IgG and IgA immunoglobulins
Exclusion of secondary causes of hypogammaglobulinemia (e.g., medications, infections, malignancies)
Recurrent bacterial infections, especially respiratory tract infections

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Persistent low serum IgM with normal IgG and IgA levels, after exclusion of secondary causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires repeated immunoglobulin measurements and clinical correlation

pathognomonic.symptomName: Normal serum IgG and IgA levels

laboratory: Normal serum IgG and IgA levels
imaging: Chest X-ray may show recurrent pneumonia or bronchiectasis
genetic: No consistent genetic mutation identified; some familial cases reported
other: Poor antibody response to polysaccharide vaccines in some patients

distinguishingFeatures: Low IgG and/or IgA in addition to IgM
More frequent autoimmune and granulomatous disease
Transient decrease in multiple immunoglobulin classes
History of immunosuppressive therapy, malignancy, or infection
Reversible upon treatment of underlying cause

redFlags: Failure to thrive or poor growth in children
references: Orange JS, Ballow M, Stiehm ER, et al.
